name: Tasa de Parpadeo
description: Analiza la tasa de parpadeo para detectar videos deepfake
algorithm: Blink Rate Analysis — Sensor/Physical Model Analyzer
mechanism:
This method analyzes eye blinking patterns for deepfake detection following Li et al. (2018) "In Ictu Oculi":

1. **Clasificación del estado ocular**: For each frame, the eye aspect ratio (EAR) is computed from eye landmarks: EAR = (‖p2−p6‖ + ‖p3−p5‖) / (2‖p1−p4‖), where p1-p6 are the eye contour landmarks. EAR drops significantly during blinks, enabling frame-level open/closed classification.

2. **Detección de eventos de parpadeo**: Consecutive frames with low EAR form blink events. Each blink is characterized by duration (typically 100-400ms in natural blinking), amplitude (EAR change magnitude), and velocity profile (rapid closing, slightly slower opening following Evinger et al., 1991).

3. **Análisis estadístico de la tasa de parpadeo**: The inter-blink interval (IBI) distribution is analyzed. Natural spontaneous blinking occurs at 15-20 blinks/minute with a characteristic IBI distribution following a gamma or log-normal model. Early deepfake methods produced subjects that rarely or never blinked — a key detection cue identified by Li et al. (2018).

4. **Evaluación de la naturalidad del parpadeo**: Individual blink kinematics are evaluated: natural blinks are bilateral (both eyes close simultaneously), show stereotyped velocity profiles, and exhibit physiological reflexes (increased blink rate during speech, periodic patterns). AI-generated blinks may appear unilateral, show unnatural velocity profiles, or lack expected behavioral correlations.

5. **Puntuación del patrón temporal**: The overall blink pattern is scored against natural human behavior models. Anomalies include: absence of blinks, unnatural blink rates, irregular blink dynamics, asymmetric blinking, or blinks that don't correspond to expected cognitive/behavioral triggers. The score quantifies deviation from natural blink physiology.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: sensor
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante blink rate analysis analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Li, Y. et al. (2018). In Ictu Oculi: Exposing AI Created Fake Videos by Detecting Eye Blinking. WIFS.
Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
